messages.text: I’ll read the new comment on PR #90 and address it on the current branch.

There are two new comments: one asks about wheel positions and spacing; the other requests closing the inner gaps with an added chamber type, simplifying the middle wheel to three shapes, and matching all three apertures to \(|\eta|<3\). I’ll implement those layout changes and check their coil clearances and effect on the station spacing.

I’m using the repository’s design-evidence and review workflows, plus `acts-spack` for any native geometry checks.
The Spack preflight flags changed setup and lockfile fingerprints again. I’ll verify the active runtime before using it. The magnetic sources can stay fixed for this chamber-layout revision.

The current inner wheel is before the endcap toroid but still intersects the barrel-toroid leg region; the middle wheel sits within both toroid regions. Moving the middle wheel beyond both toroids would crowd the outer wheel and conflict with the rear frame. I’m checking the requested simpler packing within those constraints.

There is also a real aperture constraint: at the middle wheel, some \(\eta=3\) directions pass through the endcap coil’s inner-leg reservation. The revised report will distinguish the nominal aperture from those unavoidable coil shadows.

The revised packing now has three inner-wheel shapes, three middle-wheel shapes, and one outer-wheel shape. The inner wheel gains chamber fillers on both sides of each coil slot; the middle wheel drops from 108 to 36 chambers per end.

The aperture study also confirms a limit: three simple middle-wheel shapes at the current position cannot provide uniform coverage to \(|\eta|=3\) while clearing the coils. I’ll report the nominal \(\eta=3\) dimensions and the actual coil-driven cutoffs separately.

The new geometry passes the full-volume clearance checks. All 1,024 zero-field ACTS tracks completed, and their station crossings match the independent prism calculation, including the 30 mm border check. The updated OBJ files, seven-shape inventory, and wheel cross-sections are generated.

The curved-field smoke run retained all 256 tracks; 163 stopped at the existing field-map masks. That run does not establish a momentum-resolution or reconstruction-efficiency improvement.

The revised assets are now on PR #90, and an independent reviewer is checking the exact published candidate. The report keeps the remaining limitation prominent: the fixed endcap-coil reservations prevent the middle wheel from meeting uniform \(|\eta|=3\) coverage at its present position. Meeting that target needs a physical layout change.

The independent check has reproduced the chamber counts, seam and slot areas, native crossings, and cap-bank results. It has found no material geometry defect so far; the export checks are finishing.

The spacing calculation also gives a concrete consequence of moving the middle wheel out: clearing the rear frame would push the outer wheel’s far face beyond 13.52 m, compared with 13.05 m now.

The independent review is complete. It found no new blocking defect in the constrained chamber layout and reproduced the geometry, native-event, export and historical-file checks.

I’m posting the updated drawings and OBJ links now. The reply explicitly leaves uniform middle-wheel \(|\eta|=3\) coverage unresolved because the fixed coil material blocks it.

The reply is posted on PR #90 with the new OBJ files, seven-shape inventory and cross-sections. The independent review and local checks pass for the constrained prototype; uniform middle-wheel \(|\eta|=3\) coverage remains explicitly unmet. The GitHub build is still running.

Updated [PR #90 and replied](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6287123841).

Added inner-gap fillers, simplified the middle wheel to three shapes, and regenerated OBJ files and drawings: **seven endcap chamber types** overall.

Independent checks and 1,024 straight-track ACTS checks pass. **Uniform middle-wheel \(|\eta|=3\) coverage remains blocked by the fixed toroid coils**, explicitly documented as unresolved. CI is pending.
